Your SQL just got superpowers !

Databricks just dropped a set of AI Functions that let you run powerful language and forecasting tasks directly in SQL — and it's a total game-changer.
Check out this quick demo I ran (screenshot below 👇)

Using just one line of SQL, I analyzed sentiment from customer reviews in real time.
Imagine doing this across millions of rows… IN SECONDS.

Another Example it can prioritize task- I took an example of platform support tickets queue, 
You can now auto-prioritize messages using SQL with Databricks AI functions. For example:

SELECT ai_classify("My password is leaked and I can't access the system.", ARRAY("urgent", "not urgent"));

-- Returns: urgent

Super useful for flagging critical tickets without writing complex logic or building ML models.

There are many more functions you can try out — sentiment analysis, summarization, translation, grammar correction, and more.

Explore here 👉 https://lnkd.in/dtyjgGCy
